body.title: planMigration computes per-member field rewrites
body.summary: Inside the group member loop, compare each mappable member of an anchored group against the group: epicSlug set to the label only when the label came from a real slug source (slug !== undefined) and differs from the stored slug; epicCreatedAt set to the group anchor only when deriveWorkItemIdentity(hash, memberAnchor).epicSegment differs from the group's (memberAnchor = epicCreatedAt ?? createdAt; an unparsable or missing member anchor counts as different); standalone: true when the group is standalone and the RAW stored meta.standalone is not true (readMeta surfaces the raw flag separately from the SPEC-forced Artifact.standalone). Members that are unmappable get no rewrite. Emits one MetaRewrite per member with a non-empty `set`, in group order, including already-placed (non-moving) members.
acceptanceChecks: A moved PLAN whose stored slug and day-anchor differ from its LLD head gets set { epicSlug, epicCreatedAt }
An already-placed stale member gets a rewrite with no move
Hash-fallback groups plan no epicSlug rewrite
Same-day unstamped BUILD plans no anchor rewrite; later-day plans one
Unflagged SPEC and legacy head LLD in a standalone group get only standalone: true; false is never planned
A consistent repo plans metaRewrites: [] and planning writes nothing

tests.name: planMigration: a moved PLAN whose stored epicSlug and anchor differ from its LLD head gets one metaRewrite setting both
planMigration: an already-placed member with stale metadata (no move) still gets a metaRewrite
planMigration: a hash-fallback group gets no epicSlug rewrite; anchor/standalone rewrites still planned
planMigration: a legacy unflagged head LLD in a standalone group gets only standalone: true; false is never planned
planMigration: a SPEC with no stored standalone flag in a standalone group gets standalone: true
planMigration: a same-day unstamped BUILD plans no anchor rewrite; a later-day unstamped BUILD plans epicCreatedAt = group anchor
planMigration: a consistent repo plans metaRewrites: [] and docs + .insrc stay byte-identical after planning
